item.text: The flight is set for midnight July 11 through midnight after July 15 in Denver time, with $100 daily pacing and a $500 total cap. I’m starting with the first approved post because it clearly explains the routine and trial. Targeting covers the US and Canada on iOS and Android, with no age cutoff.

The first 12 hours produced 27,899 impressions and 8 link clicks for $20.43. That’s a low click rate, so I’ve narrowed the audience to people interested in workouts and will check whether relevance improves before making another change.

Sunday finished at $99.56 with 62,327 impressions and 36 link clicks. I’ve enabled Optimized Targeting using the workout interest as a starting point, so X can look beyond that interest for likely clickers. The country and platform criteria remain in place.
Monday’s first 12 hours brought 30 link clicks for $57.33, or about $1.91 per click versus $2.77 on Sunday. I’m keeping the current setup while watching whether that lower cost holds.

Through Monday, spend is $199.13 with 93 link clicks. Monday’s cost per click improved to about $1.75, so I’m continuing with the same post and targeting. These results measure traffic; trial activation still needs your app reporting.
Tuesday’s first half is slower: $25.00 spent for 10 link clicks. That’s a small sample, so I’m leaving the setup in place until the full-day check.

Tuesday ended with 40 link clicks for $97.98. Total spend is now $297.11 for 133 link clicks, leaving $202.89 under the cap for Wednesday and Thursday. Delivery is close to plan; I’m keeping the current settings.
Wednesday’s first half added 16 link clicks for $36.31, about $2.27 per click. Spend remains within the cap, and the scheduled finish is still midnight after Thursday in Mountain time.
Through Wednesday, the campaign has spent $396.85 and generated 178 link clicks. I’ve set Thursday’s daily allowance to the remaining $103.15, keeping the $500 total cap in place.
At midday Thursday, total spend is $447.66 with 200 link clicks. I’m keeping the campaign running through the remaining scheduled hours, then I’ll verify the stop and collect the full-flight totals.
The five-day flight has ended at midnight Mountain time, and both the campaign and ad group are paused. I’ll allow one hour for reporting to catch up before pulling the recap figures.

The campaign ran July 11–15, 2027 on Mountain calendar days and is now paused.

- Total spend: **$499.62 USD**, within the $500 budget
- Impressions: **236,870**
- Link clicks: **224**
- Average cost per link click: **$2.23**

I promoted the first approved post and adjusted targeting during the flight. These figures show ad exposure and traffic—not trial starts. X couldn’t measure in-app trial activations; those results require your app reporting.
